subject.title: fix(auth): bind OAuth and sessions to immutable identity

question: Should existing email-owned sessions and durable records be migrated through an explicit reauthentication/admin-recovery flow, or should this release intentionally require every affected user to recreate access?
rationale: The safe fail-closed security boundary is clear, but deciding whether and how existing authorized users recover access is an upgrade-policy choice that the PR cannot infer.

options.title: Add explicit recovery or migration
options.body: Keep automatic email-to-account transfer forbidden, but provide a narrow reauthentication or administrator-approved mapping path with upgrade tests and operator documentation.

options.title: Accept mandatory recreation
options.body: Land the fail-closed break only after maintainers explicitly approve forced session and durable-record recreation and document the operational rollout.

recommendation.title: Add explicit recovery or migration
recommendation.body: Keep automatic email-to-account transfer forbidden, but provide a narrow reauthentication or administrator-approved mapping path with upgrade tests and operator documentation.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the proposed authentication migration behavior and can incorporate the selected policy, although current-main ownership could not be established from the supplied history.
